name: dubarr
description: Removes audio and subtitle tracks in languages you don't want from your movies and TV, without re-encoding. Files with no audio in your language are left alone and flagged. Starts in report-only mode, keeps every original in a recycle folder with one-click restore, waits for torrents to finish seeding, and tells Radarr, Sonarr and Jellyfin about each change. Set everything up in the web UI. Free forever: no paid tiers, no Pro account, no subscriptions.
